title: Rock formation like a second Sphinx head near Khentkawes' pyramid
place_text: Southeastern Giza plateau near the workers' tombs

tellings.quote: But down in there, there's this little piece of the limestone that's eroded in this really strange way where when you walk up to it, it looks like the back of another sphinx head.

plain: On the southeastern part of the Giza plateau in Egypt, near the pyramid of Khentkawes and the workers' tombs, there is said to be a piece of limestone eroded so strangely that it looks like the back of another Sphinx head. A researcher named Luke Caverns tells Michels he has walked up to it himself. If it is what it looks like, it would hint that the plateau holds more carved figures than the one famous Sphinx.
